coder.paper_coder: lead lab (RJM) RA, single coder, no reliability reported, coded with access to condition (before blinding; paper p. 5, osf nwzmt)
coder.blind_note: known difference: the lead lab's RA coded before the data were blinded (paper p. 5); the coder here is blind because the suspicion flag is strongly condition-dependent (osf q2ngk, chi2 = 51.74)
coder.output_note: a reply that indicates no suspicion, including gibberish or a non-answer, is 'no' (blank_cite: (d) excludes only indicated suspicion)
coder.provenance: recorded per run; never mixed with rule codes. Fields: coder kind (human, or model id + version), rubric version (protocol hash), date, per-reply code, confirmation that the input was blind (reply + question only), and agreement if more than one coder
coder.rescore: coded values replace needs_coder in units.suspicion; needs_coder, susp_flag, excluded_any and the suspicion exclusion (pending_if -> if) are recomputed
coder.until_coded: the suspicion exclusion is pending (exclusions.suspicion.pending_if): a run with any needs_coder reply is not scored on those sessions for the outcome, priming or positive-control targets until coded (checks report each effect's pending share); the needs_coder rate per condition is units.sessions.needs_coder (1/0) by condition
